channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Jerônimo Rodrigues: Não fechamos a porta para aquelas autoridades que não votaram em nós
item.description: Bahia Governor and reelection candidate Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) said the federal government under Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has not closed the doors to authorities who did not vote for the Workers' Party ticket, signaling openness to dialogue even with opponents. He emphasized that governability requires inclusion, regardless of electoral support received.

item.title: Convenção de Tarcísio pede voto feminino, mas não deixa mulher falar
item.description: The convention that launched Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' re-election bid in São Paulo sought to portray Bolsonarism as respectful of women, aiming to counter Michelle Bolsonaro’s allegations of mistreatment and humiliation by former President Jair Bolsonaro. Despite promoting female voter support, the event did not allow women to speak, highlighting a contradiction between its message and its actions.

item.title: Missão lança candidatura de Renan Santos à Presidência neste sábado (1º) em SP
item.description: The Missão party officially launched Renan Santos' presidential candidacy at an event in São Paulo, with Aroldo Medina as his running mate. The event also unveiled the 'Yellow Book', outlining policy proposals on security, defense, environment, and competitiveness, and confirmed gubernatorial candidates in nine states. Santos cited threats from criminal factions as justification for Medina’s selection and emphasized the need for federal police protection.

item.title: PT oficializa Jerônimo Rodrigues para concorrer ao governo da Bahia
item.description: Jerônimo Rodrigues was officially nominated as the PT's candidate for re-election as governor of Bahia at a convention in Salvador, with Lula in attendance and Geraldo Júnior (MDB) as his running mate. He currently ranks second in polls behind ACM Neto (União Brasil), who was also confirmed as the opposition's candidate. Bahia will have 11.3 million eligible voters in 2026, making it the fourth-largest electorate in Brazil.

item.title: Após racha na federação União-PP, Miguel Coelho desiste de disputar o Senado e chapa de Lyra em PE terá Eduardo da Fonte
item.description: Miguel Coelho (União Brasil), former mayor of Petrolina, withdrew his Senate candidacy in Pernambuco following a split in the União-PP federation over the gubernatorial ticket of Raquel Lyra (PSD). The state directory approved federal deputy Eduardo da Fonte (PP) as the Senate pre-candidate, while Tulio Gadelha (PSD) will also run for a Senate seat. Coelho stepped down to avoid pressure and maintain Lyra’s support.

item.title: Público deixa evento do Republicanos em SP durante fala de Tarcísio
item.description: During the Republicans' convention in São Paulo to launch Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' re-election bid, part of the audience left the Ibirapuera Gymnasium before his speech even began, with empty seats already visible as he took the stage. The exodus continued throughout his remarks, following speeches by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), Ricardo Nunes (MDB), Marcos Pereira (Republicanos) and Guilherme Derrite (PP). The incident suggests possible disengagement or weakening support among his base, even at an official campaign launch event.

item.title: Barulho de Javier Milei ajuda Flávio Bolsonaro a cumprir sua primeira meta de campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign is focused on mobilizing his most radical base through controversial agendas, such as Javier Milei's participation and conflicts with the STF, while avoiding scrutiny of his business past. The goal is to secure a runoff spot through bolsonarist loyalty, then attract right-wing voters dissatisfied with Lula. The strategy mirrors the 2018 campaign, centered on defending Jair Bolsonaro and opposing the PT, without presenting concrete policy proposals.

item.title: Ao vivo: PL realiza convenção em SC com Flávio, Carlos e Jair Renan
item.description: The Liberal Party held its convention in Santa Catarina on Saturday, August 1st, 2026, with Flávio Bolsonaro, the presidential candidate, in attendance. The event officially launched the candidacies of Carlos Bolsonaro for the Senate, Carol de Toni for the other Senate seat, Jorginho Mello for gubernatorial re-election, and Jair Renan for the Chamber of Deputies. The convention aims to strengthen Bolsonaro’s influence in the state, a key stronghold intended to boost Flávio’s advantage in the October elections.

item.title: Assista ao discurso de Wagner na convenção do PT na Bahia
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) spoke at the PT convention in Bahia on August 1, 2026, where he criticized Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's pre-candidate for president, calling him a 'traitor of the homeland' for allegedly urging foreigners to punish Brazil over the creation of Pix. Wagner did not mention the Banco Master case nor directly name Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Assista ao discurso de Rui Costa na convenção do PT na Bahia
item.description: Former Bahia governor Rui Costa spoke at the PT state convention on August 1, 2026, praising current governor Jerônimo Rodrigues for governing in alliance with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, stating Jerônimo 'was born with his butt turned to the moon' due to favorable political conditions, unlike his own tenure, which faced Temer, Bolsonaro, and the pandemic.

item.title: PL oficializa Tiago Junqueira como candidato ao Senado no Piauí
item.description: The Liberal Party officially nominated Tiago Junqueira as its Senate candidate for Piauí, with Jhamya Junqueira as his substitute, and endorsed Joel Rodrigues for governor and Flávio Bolsonaro for president. The convention, attended by Senator Ciro Nogueira, featured endorsements for both Junqueira and Bolsonaro.

item.title: Rui manda indireta para ACM: “Quem era branco ficou negro”
item.description: Former Minister Rui Costa (PT) indirectly criticized ACM Neto (União Brasil) during the party's state convention, accusing him of changing his racial self-declaration for electoral convenience. Rui pointed out that ACM Neto identified as white in 2022, then as pardo, and now again as white for the 2026 elections, suggesting identity inconsistency. The Genial/Quaest poll shows a technical tie between Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) and ACM Neto in a potential runoff, with 39% and 43% voter intention, respectively.

item.title: Wagner diz que Flávio é “traidor da pátria” e não cita caso Master
item.description: Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) accused Flávio Bolsonaro of being a 'traitor of the fatherland' for allegedly urging foreign sanctions against Brazil over Trump's new tariffs, linking the criticism to the Pix system and credit card companies' dissatisfaction. Wagner did not mention the Banco Master case, despite a PF report indicating indications he received improper economic advantages from the bank's managers, which he denies, claiming he is 'certain he will prove his innocence'.

item.title: Convenção do PT na Bahia com Lula tem pedidos de votos; lei eleitoral prevê propaganda somente a partir de 16 de agosto
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva attended the PT's state convention in Bahia and made explicit appeals for votes for his re-election and allied candidates, including Jerônimo Rodrigues, Jaques Wagner and Rui Costa, despite electoral law prohibiting campaigning before August 16. Lula referenced his three previous presidential elections and asked for a fourth term, stating he will only become an official candidate after the legal campaign period begins. He also emphasized his political alignment with Bahia’s leaders, saying he functions as a 'governor of Bahia' in spirit.

item.title: Em evento com Lula, PT oficializa candidatura de Jerônimo na Bahia
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) officially launched Jerônimo Rodrigues' candidacy for governor of Bahia at a convention in Salvador, with President Lula in attendance. The ticket includes Geraldo Júnior (MDB) as vice and Jaques Wagner and Rui Costa as Senate candidates. Although technically tied with ACM Neto (União Brasil) in polls, Jerônimo faces higher rejection (40% vs 33%), and Rui Costa indirectly criticized ACM Neto for shifting racial self-identification in past elections.

item.title: Haddad na Fazenda só serviu para ajudar o Paraguai, diz Nunes
item.description: São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB) launched a fiery attack on Fernando Haddad (PT) during the Republicanos party convention on August 1, 2026, calling him the 'worst finance minister' and claiming he 'only served to help Paraguay'. Nunes also criticized Haddad’s tenure as mayor of São Paulo (2013–2016), using insulting language such as 'little professor with an upturned nose', and urged supporters to defeat him in the first round. The São Paulo PT responded through Kiko Celeguim, accusing Nunes of disrespecting teachers and neglecting education during his administration.

item.title: Ao STF, Bolsonaro pede que irmã de Michelle cuide de filha do casal
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro requested STF authorization for Michelle Bolsonaro's sister, Geovanna Kathleen, to access the family residence to care for the couple's 15-year-old daughter while Michelle undergoes medical exams for recurrent migraines. The request stems from Bolsonaro's house arrest, which limits visits to lawyers, medical staff, and physiotherapists, requiring approval from Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Michelle also stated she has not yet decided on a Senate candidacy, awaiting the PL party convention to announce her decision.

item.title: Tarcísio chora durante louvor em convenção de candidatura ao governo
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas became emotional and cried during a worship song at the Republican Party convention that officially nominated him for re-election in São Paulo. He thanked his wife and mother, criticized the PT and Haddad, while Flávio Bolsonaro attended the event campaigning against the federal government.

item.title: Podemos anuncia apoio à Celina Leão e lança Cristian Viana ao Senado
item.description: Podemos-DF announced support for Governor Celina Leão's (PP) re-election bid and launched its regional president, Cristian Viana, as a Senate candidate. The party also confirmed 25 candidates for the CLDF and nine for the Chamber of Deputados, with Robério Negreiros leading the district list and Mayara Noronha Rocha approved as a federal candidate, though she has not yet confirmed her registration.

item.title: PCB aprova candidatura de Edmilson Costa à presidência da República
item.description: The Brazilian Communist Party (PCB) officially endorsed Edmilson Costa as its presidential candidate and Cleusa Santos as vice-presidential candidate for the October 2026 elections, during a national convention held at the São Paulo Municipal Chamber auditorium. Costa holds a PhD in economics from Unicamp and has been active in socialist militancy since his youth.

item.title: Republicanos oficializa candidatura de Tarcísio com apoio a Flávio, mas só em SP
item.description: Republicans party officially nominated Tarcísio de Freitas as their candidate for re-election as governor of São Paulo and declared support for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro solely in the São Paulo state race. The announcement was made at a state-level event by national party president Deputy Marcos Pereira.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro depende de Tarcísio para chegar no 2º turno, diz professor
item.description: Professor Fábio Andrade from ESPM stated on UOL News that the Bolsonaro family has become dependent on Tarcísio de Freitas' support to maintain electoral strength in São Paulo and sustain their national project. This dependence reflects the need for strategic alliances to reach the second round of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Haddad prometeu tudo e não entregou nada, critica Tarcísio
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas criticized Fernando Haddad, claiming he 'promised everything and delivered nothing' during his tenure as mayor of São Paulo, citing failures in education, mobility, and peripheral outreach. He emphasized Haddad's 2016 electoral defeat — where he received only 16.70% of valid votes in the first round — as clear evidence of voter rejection of his administration.

item.title: "O PT nunca governou São Paulo e não vai", diz Tarcísio em convenção
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas was confirmed as the re-election candidate at a Republicans convention, stating that "the PT never governed São Paulo and never will" and highlighting achievements like ending Cracolândia. He thanked his family, received support from allies such as Flávio Bolsonaro and Ricardo Nunes, and criticized the federal government.

item.title: Moro oficializa candidatura ao governo do Paraná e crítica Lula em convenção do PL
item.description: Sérgio Moro officially launched his candidacy for governor of Paraná at a PL convention, criticizing Lula and reaffirming his alliance with the Bolsonaro clan to defeat the PT in 2026. He emphasized that his reconciliation with Jair Bolsonaro is essential to secure the country's future, despite past differences. PL Senate candidate Filipe Barros also criticized the PT while defending his FGC-related bill and denying any ties to the Banco Master investigations.

item.title: Temos Tarcísios e Tarcísias, Lula tem Dilmos e Dilmas, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) criticized Lula and praised Tarcísio de Freitas during the Republicanos convention in São Paulo, claiming 'we have Tarcísios and Tarcísias' while 'the government has Dilmos and Dilmas' destroying the nation. He stated Brazil cannot endure four more years of PT, accused Lula of erasing his father's legacy, and sought to win over female voters by greeting Podemos leader Renata Abreu. Marcos Pereira declared Flávio his party's presidential candidate, and Daniella Marques was noted as a potential running mate.

item.title: PL oficializa Sergio Moro como candidato ao governo do Paraná
item.description: The PL officially nominated Sergio Moro as its candidate for governor of Paraná and Edson Vasconcelos as vice-governor, with federal deputy Filipe Barros and former Lava Jato prosecutor Deltan Dallagnol as Senate candidates. Moro leads in the polls and faces Requião Filho (PDT/PT) and Sandro Alex (PSD) as main opponents, supported by Podemos and Novo. His candidacy reflects a rapprochement with the Bolsonaro group after leaving União Brasil.

item.title: Ciro Nogueira "vira" Homem-Aranha azul para anunciar convenção do PP
item.description: Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP) shared an AI-generated video depicting himself as a blue Spider-Man to promote the PP convention in Piauí, which formalizes his Senate re-election bid. During the event, he declared personal support for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) for president in 2026, clarifying that the alignment applies only to the opposition bloc in Piauí, not nationally. The convention took place two months after a PF operation investigating allegations that Ciro received monthly payments of R$ 500k from businessman Daniel Vorcaro to advance Banco Master interests, which he denies.

item.title: Derrite responsabiliza Haddad pela criação do “Bolsa Crack”
item.description: Guilherme Derrite (PP-SP) blamed Fernando Haddad for creating the so-called 'Bolsa Crack', a derogatory term used by opponents to refer to the 2014 De Braços Abertos program, which provided housing, food, health care and paid work to drug users in Cracolândia as part of a harm reduction policy. Derrite claimed that the partnership between the state government, São Paulo City Hall and public security ended the Cracolândia crisis and declared his support for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) for president, stating that 'São Paulo is Bolsonaro'.

item.title: Tarcísio diz amar Bolsonaro ao ser oficializado candidato e que faria mais com Flávio presidente
item.description: The Republicans party officially nominated Tarcísio de Freitas as its candidate for re-election as governor of São Paulo in an event uniting 12 right-wing and center parties. He praised Jair Bolsonaro as a genius and charismatic leader, stating that with Flávio Bolsonaro elected president, he could achieve more for the state, citing lack of federal support over the past four years. He highlighted achievements such as the basic sanitation framework and Sabesp privatization, and pledged to end water rationing, while prioritizing housing, infrastructure, public security, literacy, and women's safety as a fundamental right.

item.title: Justiça nega retirada de vídeo em que Lula aparece com dez dedos
item.description: The Electoral Court of Ceará rejected a request by the PL party to remove from social media a video showing President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva with all ten fingers visible, which the party claimed could be misinformation. The video was shared by former minister Camilo Santana, Fortaleza Mayor Evandro Leitão, and former Civil House Chief Chagas, all from the PT. The ruling upholds freedom of expression unless falsehood or electoral fraud is proven.

item.title: Flávio faz campanha em convenção de Tarcísio e fala em "boicote" do PT
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, attended the Republicanos convention in São Paulo to support Tarcísio de Freitas’ re-election bid, accusing the federal PT government of boycotting and persecuting the São Paulo administration. He pledged to mobilize congressional support for funding if elected and made a gesture toward women in the audience, naming conservative female figures. The convention formally nominated Tarcísio as the re-election candidate, backed by a coalition of 12 parties.

item.title: Presidente do Republicanos diz que Flávio é seu candidato ao Planalto
item.description: Marcos Pereira, national president of the Republicans party, declared Flávio Bolsonaro as the party's presidential candidate for 2026 during the state convention that also confirmed Tarcísio de Freitas as the party's gubernatorial re-election candidate in São Paulo. Daniella Marques, former president of Caixa and a Republicans member, was mentioned as a potential running mate for Flávio and attended the event alongside him. Flávio thanked Pereira’s support in a lighthearted manner, joking that he gave Marcos 'a kiss today'.

item.title: PSTU oficializa Hertz Dias como candidato à Presidência da República
item.description: The PSTU officially nominated Hertz Dias as its presidential candidate and Vanessa Portugal as vice-presidential candidate at a convention held at the São Paulo Metro Workers' Union headquarters. The ticket aims to link critiques of capitalism, social inequality, and racism into a unified socialist political project independent of both the far-right and the Lula government.

item.title: Presidente do Republicanos declara apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro em São Paulo
item.description: The national president of the Republicans, Marcos Pereira, declared support for Flávio Bolsonaro as presidential candidate only in São Paulo, emphasizing that there is still no national definition for the party. The support comes as Flávio seeks national alliances, while the Progressive Union and Podemos are expected to remain neutral in the first round. The indefinition of support is delaying the announcement of Flávio Bolsonaro’s running mate.

item.title: Moro mira Lula e minimiza Flávio em caso Master ao se lançar no Paraná
item.description: Sergio Moro officially launched his candidacy for governor of Paraná, using the occasion to nationalize the state campaign by criticizing Lula and downplaying suspicions against Flávio Bolsonaro in the Master case. He acknowledged 'some divergence and some resentment' in his break with the Bolsonaro family but emphasized a 'bigger project' to defeat the Workers' Party candidate in 2026.

item.title: Decorativo ou participativo? O papel de Geraldo Alckmin na campanha de Lula
item.description: Lula praised Geraldo Alckmin as a loyal, capable, and honest vice president, emphasizing his importance in the governing partnership and in overcoming economic sector distrust in 2022. Although retained on the ticket for re-election, Alckmin has yet to define his role in the 2026 PT campaign, with PSB allies fearing he may be relegated to symbolic functions due to the PT's internal struggle for power.

item.title: Três Poderes: Valdemar é o vencedor da semana; Cleitinho, o perdedor
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, was named the week's winner for placing his marketer, Duda Lima, in Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign and securing Michelle Bolsonaro's Senate candidacy in the Federal District. These moves strengthen the PL's influence in the 2026 elections, particularly around the Bolsonaro clan.

item.title: Nikolas critica Lula e diz que desumano é “morar na casa dos pobres”
item.description: Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) criticized President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for calling life in the Palácio da Alvorada 'inhumane', arguing that true inhumanity lies in the poverty Lula claims to have fought. Nikolas pointed out that in the homes of the poor, there is no refrigerator, warm beer, or spacious rooms — unlike in the official residence.

item.title: Republicanos oficializa Tarcísio candidato ao governo de SP
item.description: The Republican Party officially nominated Tarcísio de Freitas for re-election as governor of São Paulo at a convention held at Ibirapuera, attended by allies including Flávio Bolsonaro, Felício Ramuth, and Ricardo Nunes. Recent polls show Tarcísio leading with 41% voting intention, surpassing the combined total of other candidates, suggesting a potential first-round victory.

item.title: Com Flávio Bolsonaro, Tarcísio oficializa candidatura à reeleição
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) officially launched his re-election bid at a convention held at the Ibirapuera Gymnasium, attended by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), who is running for president, and São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB). The event underscored the political alliance between Bolsonaro-aligned figures in the state, emphasizing mutual support between state and federal candidacies.

item.title: Raquel Lyra e João Campos empatam no 2º turno em PE, diz Datafolha
item.description: A Datafolha poll released on July 31, 2026 shows Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) at 49% and former Recife mayor João Campos (PSB) at 45% in a hypothetical runoff for Pernambuco governor, technically tied within the 3-point margin of error. The survey also indicates Eduardo da Fonte (PP) has been consolidated as the Senate candidate on Lyra’s ticket following Miguel Coelho’s (União Brasil) withdrawal, announced in a video on August 1, 2026.

item.title: Raquel Lyra recua e escolhe Eduardo da Fonte para o Senado
item.description: Pernambuco Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) reversed her earlier stance and selected federal deputy Eduardo da Fonte (PP) as her Senate candidate for the 2026 elections. The decision ends an internal dispute with former Petrolina mayor Miguel Coelho (União Brasil), who withdrew his Senate bid after a meeting with the governor.

item.title: Convenção confirma Tarcísio como candidato à reeleição em SP
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) was confirmed as the reelection candidate in São Paulo during a party convention at Ibirapuera, backed by a coalition of 12 parties. The ticket includes Felício Ramuth (MDB) as vice governor and Senate candidates André do Prado (PL) and Guilherme Derrite (PP), with Flávio Bolsonaro attending as a presidential ally.

item.title: Exposição no Amazonas celebra os 30 anos da urna eletrônica
item.description: The exhibition "30 years of the Electronic Ballot Box: The evolution that strengthens democracy" was held at Manaus Via Norte Shopping in July 2026 by the TRE-AM to celebrate three decades of Brazil's electronic voting system. The display traced the evolution of voting equipment from canvas ballot boxes to modern electronic urns, featuring original historical documents, photographs, and an interactive vote where visitors chose between "Technology" (current electronic urn) and "Nostalgia" (old canvas urn).

item.title: Ataque cibernético atinge líderes petistas na madrugada de convenção na Bahia, diz partido
item.description: Three PT leaders from Bahia — Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues, Senator Jaques Wagner, and former minister Rui Costa — were targeted in a cyberattack in the early hours of June 1st, during the Brazil of Hope Federation convention in Salvador. Their Instagram accounts received 70,000 followers of Asian origin within five hours, prompting account closures and a police report filed with the DRCC. The Federation claims the attack aims to falsely accuse them of buying followers and to trick Meta into suspending their profiles during the electoral period.

item.title: PE: Miguel Coelho deixa disputa ao Senado na chapa de Raquel Lyra
item.description: Former Petrolina mayor Miguel Coelho (União Brasil) announced his withdrawal from the Senate race in Governor Raquel Lyra’s (PSD) ticket to avoid internal conflict within the União Brasil-PP federation. The decision, made after a meeting with Lyra, clears the way for federal deputy Eduardo da Fonte (PP) to run alongside Túlio Gadelha (PSD) for the two Senate seats. Coelho expressed regret, citing 'greater forces,' but affirmed his continued political resolve.

item.title: Zema vai privatizar Petrobras, Banco do Brasil e Correios no 1º ano, diz conselheiro
item.description: Carlos da Costa, economic advisor to Romeu Zema (Novo), stated that Zema’s government plan includes privatizing Petrobras, Banco do Brasil, and Caixa Econômica Federal in the first year of office, along with selling up to a quarter of the federal government’s real estate. The plan rests on four pillars: fiscal balance, reducing the 'Brazil Cost,' preparing for 21st-century work, and alleviating debt, inspired by the Heritage Foundation’s platform for Trump. Zema also proposes reinstating the spending cap, creating an automatic tax cut trigger when revenue rises, and launching emergency versions of Pronampe and open scoring to improve credit access.

item.title: Bastidores: Lula apela ao pragmatismo e fala em corrigir gastança caso reeleito
item.description: Lula appeals to pragmatism, signaling that if re-elected, he would adopt unpopular measures to curb public spending despite his electoral largesse exceeding 200 billion reais. While his economic team previously downplayed the urgency of fiscal adjustment, there are indications he may reverse his own stimulus to avoid crisis. Government approval rose to 48%, surpassing disapproval (47%) for the first time since December 2024, driven by electoral measures.

item.title: No Nordeste, PT enfrenta dificuldade, mas Lula continua a nadar de braçada
item.description: In the Northeast, the PT faces challenges in state races, with Jerônimo Rodrigues technically tied with ACM Neto in Bahia, Elmano de Freitas trailing Ciro Gomes in Ceará, and no PT candidate in Pernambuco, where Raquel Lyra leads João Campos. Despite this, Lula maintains strong support in the region, with potential to increase his vote margin over 2022 levels, as PT candidates hope to benefit from vote transfer. The Northeast remains pivotal for Lula, who could gain up to 8.7 million more votes than his rival in 2026.
